### 1. Transcription data analysis

```{r transcription-data-cleaning-pipeline, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

# helper function: scoring keywords

# clean special characters
mgsub <- function(pattern, replacement, x, ...) {
  result <- x
  for (i in 1:length(pattern)) {
    result <- gsub(pattern[i], replacement[i], result, ...)
  }
  result
}

# keywords scoring
num.keywords.correct <- function(transcription, keywords) {
  keys <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(keywords)))
  trans <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(transcription)))
  keys.list <- unlist(strsplit(keys, " "))
  trans.list <- unlist(strsplit(trans, " "))
  return(sum(!is.na(pmatch(keys.list, trans.list))))
}

# keywords checking
check_keywords_correct <- function(transcription, keywords, trial_id, filename, participant_id) {
  keys <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(keywords)))
  trans <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(transcription)))
  keys.list <- unlist(strsplit(keys, " "))
  trans.list <- unlist(strsplit(trans, " "))
  
  correct_matches <- keys.list %in% trans.list
  
  return(data.frame(
    trial_id = trial_id,
    participant_id = participant_id,
    Filename = filename,
    keyword = keys.list,
    is_correct = correct_matches
  ))
}

clean_questionnaire_robust <- function(file_path) {
  df_raw <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df_subset <- df_raw %>%
    filter(stimuli_presented %in% c("exposure_spanish_accent", "exposure_spanish")) %>%
    select(participant_id, question_id = stimuli_presented, answer = response_value)
  
  df_wide <- df_subset %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = question_id, values_from = answer) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("quest_", .), .cols = -participant_id)
  
  return(df_wide)
}


# batch processing transcription data
process_transcription_batch <- function(folder_name, group_label, batch_label, has_questionnaire) {
  
  message(paste("Processing:", batch_label, "..."))
  
  target_folder <- file.path("../data/preprocessed", folder_name)
  trans_file <- list.files(target_folder, pattern = "transcription_data.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)[1]
  key_file <- "../data/transcription_scoring.txt"
  
  if(is.na(trans_file)) { warning(paste("Missing data for", batch_label)); return(NULL) }

  d <- read.csv(trans_file)
  key.df <- read.delim(key_file, header = TRUE, sep = ",")
  key.df$Sentence <- as.character(key.df$Sentence)
  
  d.trans <- subset(d, !is.na(stimulus_files_presented) & stimulus_files_presented != "" & block == "Transcription")
  d.trans$Filename <- basename(as.character(d.trans$stimulus_files_presented))
  d.trans$Transcription <- d.trans$response_value
  
  d.all.m <- merge(d.trans, subset(key.df, select = -c(SentenceSet)),
                   by.x = "Filename", by.y = "Sentence", sort = FALSE)
  
  chars <- c("<", ">", '"', ",", ";", "|", "'")
  char_codes <- c("&lt&", "&gt&", "&quot&", "&comma&", "&semicol&", "&pipe&", "&apos&")
  
  d.all.m <- within(d.all.m, {
    Transcription <- tolower(mgsub(char_codes, chars, Transcription))
    NumKeywordsCorrect <- mapply(num.keywords.correct, Transcription, Keywords)
    PropKeywordsCorrect <- NumKeywordsCorrect / NumKeywords
  })
  

  d.all.m$trial_id <- 1:nrow(d.all.m)
  

  d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent <- NA 
  if(has_questionnaire) {
    quest_file <- list.files(target_folder, pattern = "questionnaire_data.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)[1]
    if(!is.na(quest_file)) {
      df_quest <- clean_questionnaire_robust(quest_file)
      d.all.m <- left_join(d.all.m, df_quest, by = "participant_id")
      if("quest_exposure_spanish_accent.y" %in% names(d.all.m)) {
        d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent <- d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent.y
      }
    }
  } 
  
  d.all.m$batch_id <- batch_label
  d.all.m$group <- group_label 
  
  return(d.all.m)
}

run_transcription_plots <- function(df_input) {
  
  
  # Overall Distribution
  mean_scores <- df_input %>% group_by(batch_id) %>% summarise(M = mean(PropKeywordsCorrect))
  p1 <- ggplot(df_input, aes(x = PropKeywordsCorrect)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(data = mean_scores, aes(xintercept = M), color = "darkorange", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~batch_id) +
    labs(title = "P1: Distribution of Transcription Performance", x = "Proportion Correct") +
    theme_bw()
  
  # Participant Performance 
  summ_subj <- df_input %>% group_by(batch_id, participant_id) %>% summarise(Mean = mean(PropKeywordsCorrect), .groups="drop")
  p2 <- ggplot(summ_subj, aes(x = batch_id, y = Mean, fill = batch_id)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.3) +
    geom_jitter(width=0.2, color="darkred", size=2, alpha=0.6) +
    labs(title = "P2: Transcription Performance by Participant", y = "Mean Proportion Correct") +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="none")

  # Item Difficulty Distribution
  item_means_batch <- df_input %>%
    group_by(Filename, batch_id) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(PropKeywordsCorrect), .groups="drop")
  
  mean_item_diff <- item_means_batch %>% group_by(batch_id) %>% summarise(M = mean(Mean))
  
  p3 <- ggplot(item_means_batch, aes(x = Mean)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, fill = "mediumpurple", color = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(data = mean_item_diff, aes(xintercept = M), color = "gold", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
    facet_wrap(~batch_id) + # <--- Now faceted!
    labs(title = "P3: Distribution of Item Difficulty", x = "Mean Prop Correct (per Sentence)") +
    theme_bw()

  # Sentence Difficulty 
  item_means_clean <- item_means_batch %>% mutate(Filename_clean = gsub(".wav", "", Filename))
  
  p4 <- ggplot(item_means_clean, aes(x = Mean, y = reorder(Filename_clean, Mean))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Mean), size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~batch_id, scales="free_x") + # <--- Split by batch
    scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "green") +
    labs(title = "P4: Difficulty of Individual Sentences", x = "Mean Proportion Correct", y = "Sentence") +
    theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size=6))

  # Performance by Number of Keywords 
  p5 <- ggplot(df_input, aes(x = NumKeywords, y = PropKeywordsCorrect, color = batch_id)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se=FALSE) + 
    labs(title = "P5: Performance by Number of Keywords", x = "Number of Keywords", y = "Proportion Correct") +
    theme_bw()

  message("  - Calculating keyword-level accuracy by batch...")
  keyword_long_df <- pmap_dfr(
    list(df_input$Transcription, df_input$Keywords, df_input$trial_id, df_input$Filename, df_input$participant_id),
    check_keywords_correct 
  )

  keyword_long_df <- keyword_long_df %>% 
    left_join(df_input %>% select(trial_id, batch_id), by="trial_id")

  # Accuracy for Individual Keywords
  keyword_acc_batch <- keyword_long_df %>% 
    group_by(Filename, keyword, batch_id) %>% 
    summarise(P = mean(is_correct), .groups="drop")
  
  p6 <- ggplot(keyword_acc_batch, aes(x = reorder(keyword, P), y = P, fill = batch_id)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width=0.8), color="black", width=0.7) + 
    facet_wrap(~ Filename, scales = "free_x") + 
    labs(title = "P6: Accuracy for Individual Keywords (by Batch)", x = "Keyword") +
    theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size=6), legend.position="top")

  # Top 20 Hardest Keywords
  overall_kw_batch <- keyword_long_df %>% 
    group_by(keyword, batch_id) %>% 
    summarise(P = mean(is_correct), N=n(), .groups="drop") %>% 
    group_by(batch_id) %>%
    arrange(P) %>% slice_head(n=20) 
  
  p7 <- ggplot(overall_kw_batch, aes(x = reorder(keyword, P), y = P, fill=batch_id)) +
    geom_col(color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~batch_id, scales="free_y") + 
    labs(title = "P7: Top 20 Hardest Keywords per Batch", x = "Keyword", y = "Proportion Correct") +
    coord_flip() + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="none")

  # Accuracy Over Time (Group Average)
  summ_time <- df_input %>%
    group_by(trial_order, group) %>%
    summarise(stats = list(smean.cl.boot(PropKeywordsCorrect)), .groups="drop") %>%
    tidyr::unnest_wider(stats)
  
  p8 <- ggplot(summ_time, aes(x = trial_order, y = Mean, color = group, fill=group)) +
    geom_line(linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=Lower, ymax=Upper), alpha=0.2, linetype=0) +
    geom_smooth(data=df_input, aes(x=trial_order, y=PropKeywordsCorrect), method="lm", se=TRUE, alpha=0.1) +
    labs(title = "P8: Accuracy Over Time (Group Trend)", x="Trial", y="Mean Accuracy") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1)) + theme_bw()

  # Individual Accuracy Over Time 
  p9 <- ggplot(df_input, aes(x = trial_order, y = PropKeywordsCorrect, color=batch_id)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ participant_id, ncol = 4) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.0)) + 
    labs(title = "P9: Individual Participant Trends", color="Batch") +
    theme_bw() + theme(strip.text = element_text(size=6), legend.position="top")

  # Accent Familiarity
  summ_data <- df_input %>%
    group_by(batch_id) %>%
    summarise(stats = list(smean.cl.boot(PropKeywordsCorrect)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::unnest_wider(stats)
  p10 <- ggplot(summ_data, aes(x = batch_id, y = Mean, color = batch_id)) +
    geom_jitter(data = df_input, aes(y = PropKeywordsCorrect), alpha = 0.1, width=0.2) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), width = 0.1, linewidth = 1.2) +
    labs(title = "P10: Group Comparison (Bootstrapped)", x="Group") + theme_bw()

  p_11 <- NULL
  if("quest_exposure_spanish_accent" %in% names(df_input)) {
    df_fam <- df_input %>% filter(!is.na(quest_exposure_spanish_accent))
    if(nrow(df_fam) > 0) {
       df_fam <- df_fam %>%
        mutate(fam = factor(as.numeric(quest_exposure_spanish_accent), levels=1:5, labels=c("Never", "Sometimes", "Half", "Often", "Always"))) %>%
        group_by(participant_id, group, fam) %>% summarise(M=mean(PropKeywordsCorrect), .groups="drop")
      
      p_fam <- ggplot(df_fam, aes(x = fam, y = M, fill=group)) +
        geom_boxplot(alpha=0.4) + geom_point(position=position_jitterdodge(), alpha=0.6) +
        labs(title = "P11: Familiarity vs Accuracy") + theme_bw()
    }
  }

  print(p1); print(p2); print(p3); print(p4); print(p5); 
  print(p6); print(p7); print(p8); print(p9); print(p10)
  if(!is.null(p_fam)) print(p_fam)
  
  message("Successfully generated all plots!")
}
```

### 2. Error detection data analysis


```{r error-detection-data-cleaning-pipeline, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}


# questionnaire data cleaning
clean_questionnaire_robust <- function(file_path) {
  
  df_raw <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df_subset <- df_raw %>%
    select(participant_id, 
           question_id = stimuli_presented, 
           answer = response_value)
  
  df_wide <- df_subset %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = question_id,
      values_from = answer
    )
  
  df_final <- df_wide %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("quest_", .), .cols = -participant_id)
  
  return(df_final)
}

# batch processing for annotated error detection data
process_batch_error_detection <- function(batch_pattern, batch_label, folder_name) {
  
  message(paste("Processing:", batch_label, "..."))
  
 # find annotated files
  annotated_files <- list.files(
    path = "../data/annotated/", 
    pattern = paste0(batch_pattern, ".*(FB|JB)\\.csv"), 
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  if(length(annotated_files) == 0) {
    warning(paste("  ! Skipping", batch_label, "- No annotated files found."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # find questionnaire data
  target_folder <- file.path("../data/preprocessed", folder_name)
  quest_file <- list.files(path = target_folder, pattern = "questionnaire_data.csv", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)[1]
  
  if(is.na(quest_file)) {
    warning(paste("  ! Skipping", batch_label, "- No questionnaire found."))
    return(NULL)
  }

  
  df_exp <- map_dfr(annotated_files, read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% distinct()
  
  # filter participants who did not engage with the experiment
  # this means that there will be no coder names
  df_exp <- df_exp %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% filter(any(!is.na(coder))) %>% ungroup()
  
  # attention checks
  df_exp <- df_exp %>%
    mutate(
      comments = as.character(comments),
      attention_score_8 = as.numeric(str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/8)")),
      attention_score_7 = as.numeric(str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/7)"))
    )
  
  failed_ids <- unique(c(
    df_exp %>% filter(attention_score_8 < 6) %>% pull(participant_id),
    df_exp %>% filter(attention_score_7 == 4) %>% pull(participant_id)
  ))
  
  df_exp <- df_exp %>% mutate(attention_check_passed = !participant_id %in% failed_ids)
  

  df_quest_clean <- clean_questionnaire_robust(quest_file)
  
  # join data
  df_final <- df_exp %>%
    left_join(df_quest_clean, by = "participant_id") %>%
    mutate(batch_id = batch_label) 
  
  return(df_final)
}

##### power analysis on 3 test run subejcts #####
install.packages("pwr")
library(pwr)


# calculate two distinct "scores" for every trial:
# 1. score_phon: Did they find the Phonological error?
# 2. score_nonphon: Did they find the Non-Phonological error?

df_power_prep <- df_analysis_targets %>%
  mutate(
    score_phon = case_when(
      err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both") ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    score_nonphon = case_when(
      err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both") ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )


run_paired_power <- function(data, cond1_name, cond2_name, metric1, metric2, label) {
  
  d1 <- data %>% filter(condition == cond1_name) %>% select(participant_id, val = all_of(metric1))
  d2 <- data %>% filter(condition == cond2_name) %>% select(participant_id, val = all_of(metric2))
  
  paired_data <- inner_join(d1, d2, by = "participant_id", suffix = c("_c1", "_c2")) %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_c1 = mean(val_c1),
      mean_c2 = mean(val_c2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(diff = mean_c1 - mean_c2)
  
  # calculate effect size
  mean_diff <- mean(paired_data$diff)
  sd_diff <- sd(paired_data$diff)
  
  if (is.na(sd_diff) || sd_diff == 0) {
    effect_d <- 0.5 # Default fallback
    note <- " (Defaulted due to 0 variance)"
  } else {
    effect_d <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    note <- ""
  }
  

  pwr_out <- pwr.t.test(
    d = abs(effect_d), 
    power = 0.80, 
    sig.level = 0.05, 
    type = "paired", 
    alternative = "two.sided"
  )
  
  return(tibble(
    Hypothesis = label,
    Condition_A = cond1_name,
    Condition_B = cond2_name,
    Effect_Size_d = round(effect_d, 3),
    Required_N = ceiling(pwr_out$n),
    Note = note
  ))
}


# Analysis 1: Does adding Non-Phon mask Phon?
# compare Phon detection in 'phon_err' vs 'both_err'
res1 <- run_paired_power(df_power_prep, "phon_err", "both_err", "score_phon", "score_phon", "1. Phon Interference")

# Analysis 2: Does adding Phon mask Non-Phon?
# compare Non-Phon detection in 'non_phon_err' vs 'both_err'
res2 <- run_paired_power(df_power_prep, "non_phon_err", "both_err", "score_nonphon", "score_nonphon", "2. Non-Phon Interference")

# Analysis 3: Is Phon easier to spot than Non-Phon?
# compare Phon detection in 'phon_err' vs Non-Phon detection in 'non_phon_err'
res3 <- run_paired_power(df_power_prep, "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "score_phon", "score_nonphon", "3. Relative Salience")



final_table <- bind_rows(res1, res2, res3)

print(final_table)

max_n <- max(final_table$Required_N)
safe_n <- max_n + 5 

# An a priori power analysis based on data from the test run where the randomization worked correctly (N=3). For the primary hypothesis (Phonological Interference: Does the presence of a second error (Non-Phonological) make it harder for the participant to spot the Phonological error?), it suggested that a sample size of N=26 would be sufficient to achieve 80% power at alpha=.05. If we account for participant exclusion rates and we want to improve sensitivity for secondary and other hypotheses, we could set a target sample size of N=40
```

##### 2.1 Analysis and plots

```{r error-detection-functions-to-create-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}


run_plotting_pipeline <- function(df_input) {
  
  df_input <- df_input %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    mutate(trial_num_sequential = match(question, unique(question))) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  df_analysis <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    mutate(
      err_reported_clean = case_when(
        err_reported == "nanas" ~ "nans",
        TRUE ~ err_reported
      ),
      condition = factor(condition, levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err")),
      err_reported_label = case_when(
        err_reported_clean == "nans" ~ "Question has no errors",
        err_reported_clean == "nun"  ~ "Unsure",
        err_reported_clean == "y"    ~ "Question needs correction"
      ),
      attempt_label = case_when(
        err_reported_attempt == "first" ~ "First Attempt",
        err_reported_attempt == "secsame" ~ "Second Attempt (Same/Skip)",
        err_reported_attempt == "secdiff" ~ "Second Attempt (Changed)",
        TRUE ~ err_reported_attempt
      ),
      accuracy_label = case_when(
        no_err_response == "a" ~ "Accurate",
        no_err_response == "w" ~ "Wrong",
        no_err_response == "blank" ~ "Blank",
        no_err_response == "corrected" ~ "Corrected",
        no_err_response == "twice" ~ "Same Response Twice",
        TRUE ~ no_err_response
      ),
      quest_exposure_spanish_accent = factor(
        as.numeric(quest_exposure_spanish_accent), 
        levels = 1:5, 
        labels = c("Never", "Sometimes", "Half the time", "Often", "All the time"), 
        ordered = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(err_reported_clean %in% c("y", "nans", "nun"))


  df_trial_level <- df_analysis %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      is_reported = any(err_reported_clean == "y"),
      detected_phon = any(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both")),
      detected_nonphon = any(err_reported_clean == "y" & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both")),
      final_label = case_when(
        any(err_reported_clean == "y") ~ "Question needs correction",
        any(err_reported_clean == "nun") ~ "Unsure",
        TRUE ~ "Question has no errors"
      ),
      quest_exposure_spanish_accent = first(quest_exposure_spanish_accent),
      trial_num = first(trial_num_sequential), 
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # (A) Was there error reported?
  plot_data_A_part <- df_trial_level %>%
    count(participant_id, condition, final_label) %>%
    complete(participant_id, condition, final_label, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    group_by(participant_id, condition) %>%
    mutate(Total = sum(n), Prop = n / Total) %>%
    ungroup()

  plot_summary_err_reported <- plot_data_A_part %>%
    group_by(condition, final_label) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Proportion = mean(Prop, na.rm=TRUE), 
      SE = sd(Prop, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(ymin = Mean_Proportion - SE, ymax = Mean_Proportion + SE) %>%
    rename(err_reported_label = final_label)

  p_grouped_chart_err_reported <- ggplot(plot_summary_err_reported, 
                                         aes(x = condition, y = Mean_Proportion, fill = err_reported_label, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.25, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(x = "Condition", y = "Proportion of Responses", fill = "Participant Response", title = "Did participants report an error?") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12), legend.position = "top")


  # (B) Hit Rate: Detection of Intended Errors
  plot_data_B <- df_trial_level %>%
    filter(condition != "correct") %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(phon=mean(detected_phon), nonphon=mean(detected_nonphon)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-condition, names_to="Type", values_to="Rate") %>%
    filter((condition=="phon_err" & Type=="phon") | (condition=="non_phon_err" & Type=="nonphon") | (condition=="both_err"))
  
  pB <- ggplot(plot_data_B, aes(x=condition, y=Rate, fill=Type)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge", color="black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("phon"="skyblue", "nonphon"="salmon")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=percent, limits=c(0,1)) +
    labs(title="(B) Hit rate: Did participants report the intended error(s)?") + theme_bw()

  # (C) When was the error reported?
  pC <- ggplot(df_analysis %>% filter(err_reported_clean=="y", !is.na(attempt_label)), 
               aes(x=condition, fill=attempt_label)) +
    geom_bar(position="fill", color="black") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette="Pastel1") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=percent) +
    labs(title="(C) When did participants report the error?", y="Proportion") + theme_bw()

  # (D) Accuracy of 'No Error' Responses
  pD <- ggplot(df_analysis %>% filter(err_reported_clean=="nans", !is.na(accuracy_label)), 
               aes(x=condition, fill=accuracy_label)) +
    geom_bar(position="fill", color="black") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette="Paired") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=percent) +
    labs(title="(D) Did participants answered the trivia question correctly when NO error was reported?", y="Proportion") + theme_bw()

  # (E) Detailed Error Type Breakdown 
  pE <- ggplot(df_analysis %>% filter(err_reported_clean=="y") %>% count(condition, err_type_response) %>% group_by(condition) %>% mutate(P=n/sum(n)), 
               aes(x=err_type_response, y=P, fill=condition)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black") +
    facet_wrap(~condition, scales="free_x") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=percent) +
    labs(title="(E) Detailed breakdown of reported error types") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="none")

  # (F) Detection Over Time 
  pF <- ggplot(df_trial_level %>% filter(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err")), 
               aes(x=trial_num, y=as.integer(detected_phon), color=condition)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.3, position=position_jitter(height=0.05)) +
    geom_smooth(method="glm", method.args=list(family="binomial")) +
    labs(title="(F) What did the phonological error detection rate look like over time?") + theme_bw()

  # (G1) Accent Familiarity x Hit Rate
  plot_data_G <- df_trial_level %>%
    filter(!is.na(quest_exposure_spanish_accent), condition!="correct") %>%
    group_by(quest_exposure_spanish_accent, condition) %>%
    summarise(phon=mean(detected_phon), nonphon=mean(detected_nonphon), .groups="drop") %>%
    pivot_longer(c(phon, nonphon), names_to="Type", values_to="Rate") %>%
    filter((condition=="phon_err"&Type=="phon")|(condition=="non_phon_err"&Type=="nonphon")|(condition=="both_err"))

  pG1 <- ggplot(plot_data_G, aes(x=condition, y=Rate, fill=Type)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge", color="black") +
    facet_wrap(~quest_exposure_spanish_accent) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("phon"="skyblue", "nonphon"="salmon")) +
    labs(title="(G1) How did accent ramiliarity affect hit rate?") + theme_bw() + 
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))

  # (G2) Detection Over Time by Familiarity
  pG2 <- ggplot(df_trial_level %>% filter(!is.na(quest_exposure_spanish_accent), condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err")),
                aes(x=trial_num, y=as.integer(detected_phon), color=condition)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.2) +
    geom_smooth(method="glm", method.args=list(family="binomial")) +
    facet_wrap(~quest_exposure_spanish_accent) +
    labs(title="(G2) How did accent familiarity affect phonological error detection rate over time?") + theme_bw()

  # (H) False Alarms
  pH <- ggplot(df_trial_level %>% filter(condition=="correct") %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% summarise(Rate=mean(is_reported)), 
               aes(x=Rate)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth=0.05, fill="salmon", color="black") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(Rate)), color="red", linetype="dashed") +
    labs(title="(H) What does the false alarm rate look like?") + theme_bw()

  # (I) Interference 
  pI1 <- ggplot(df_trial_level %>% filter(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err")), 
                aes(x=condition, y=as.integer(detected_phon), fill=condition)) +
    stat_summary(fun="mean", geom="bar", color="black") +
    stat_summary(fun.data="mean_se", geom="errorbar", width=0.2) +
    labs(title="(I1) Does Non-Phon mask Phon error?") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="none")

  pI2 <- ggplot(df_trial_level %>% filter(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err")), 
                aes(x=condition, y=as.integer(detected_nonphon), fill=condition)) +
    stat_summary(fun="mean", geom="bar", color="black") +
    stat_summary(fun.data="mean_se", geom="errorbar", width=0.2) +
    labs(title="(I2) Does Phon mask Non-Phon error?") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="none")

  print(p_grouped_chart_err_reported)
  print(pB); print(pC); print(pD); print(pE); 
  print(pF); print(pG1); print(pG2); print(pH); print(pI1); print(pI2)
  
  message("--- Successfully generated all plots! ---")
}
```


```{r execute-the-plots-error-detection, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

run_plotting_pipeline(df_clean_all_trials)
```
